coordinate_system: unchanged concept local metres: X east, Y up, Z north
scope: four projected facades only; hidden returns and courtyard walls need adapter review
geometry_authority: frozen V0.3 rectangles, replacing earlier per-bay windows
plane_derivation: grid*(depth_cell+1) for N/E, grid*depth_cell for S/W; verify wall face against occupied cells before voxelizing
material_rule: same nearest eligible panel mapping as V0.3 elevation renderer
thickness_policy: surface bounds have zero thickness; HAF decides wall/glass layer thickness without filling voids
screen_policy: orange fins in front of screen glazing; fin section, offset and collision require an adapter sample
